messages:
Adele Park: Heads-up — running a preflight pager drill during the maintenance window tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. Goal: validate cross-region escalation and statuspage publish flow. No customer-facing changes planned unless we hit an actual incident. pls ack if you're on rotation.

ops-bot: Incident drill scheduled by @Adele Park for 2025-03-15 23:00 UTC. Pager will target SRE rotation. This is a drill — tag with #drill.

Matt K: ack, I'll be on-call at 23:00. I'll mute non-essential alerts and route critical pages to phone.

Sanjay Rao: ack. I'll shadow Matt and handle statuspage/comms if anything shows up.

Lia Chen: ack. I'll stand by for any customer notifications and pair on copy.

Adele Park: quick checklist before we start:
- runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pager-drills (use the drill section)
- post statuspage draft to #incidents-drafts channel before publishing
- use the template below for customer notify if we need to escalate

Adele Park: ```
Customer notification template (do not send unless real impact):
Subject: Redwood Inference — Temporary degradation in {region}
Hi {CustomerName},
We’re investigating an issue affecting inference requests in {region}. Our team is actively mitigating and we’ll share updates on status.redwood.ai. No action needed from you at this time.
Estimated next update: {ETA}
Apologies for the disruption — team at Redwood
```

Matt K: starting drill now. generating a synthetic high-priority alert to validate phone routing.

ops-bot: Pager sent to SRE-oncall (phone) at 2025-03-15T23:02:12Z. Drill tag: #drill.

Matt K: got the page on phone + Slack. responding with 2 min latency. testing secondary escalation to ENG-SRE group.

Sanjay Rao: statuspage draft pushed to #incidents-drafts — please review before publish. Draft text attached: ```
We are currently conducting a scheduled preflight drill for our maintenance window. No customer impact expected. If any customer-facing issues are detected we will update this page.
```

Lia Chen: edited draft to include expected maintenance window and contact link. New draft: ```
Scheduled maintenance preflight drill in progress (Mar 15 23:00 UTC — 23:30 UTC). No customer impact is expected. For updates visit https://status.redwood.ai or contact support@redwood.ai.
```

Matt K: second synthetic alert failed to route to secondary escalation — looks like a missing rotation mapping for ENG-SRE. I'm on it.

Adele Park: assign a quick remediation task — Sanjay, can you patch the rotation mapping? If it requires a rebuild schedule, call it out.

Sanjay Rao: digging in — found stale mapping in /ops/oncall-config. Will push fix as hotpatch, then re-trigger drill. ETA 8m.

ops-bot: Change detected in /ops/oncall-config by sanjay:hotpatch. Initiating smoke check.

Matt K: re-triggering synthetic alert now.

ops-bot: Pager sent to SRE-oncall (phone) at 2025-03-15T23:11:47Z. Drill tag: #drill.

Matt K: got it. secondary escalation now goes to ENG-SRE as expected. Good.

Lia Chen: Because we briefly had a mapping issue, I recommend we publish a short internal note and prepare a customer-facing FYI just in case — even though there was no actual customer impact. Draft internal blurb below:```
Internal: During preflight pager drill at 23:00 UTC we observed a stale oncall rotation mapping that caused secondary escalation to fail for ~9 minutes. No customer impact detected. Oncall mapping hotpatched by @Sanjay Rao. Recommend follow-up: schedule config validation in CI and add unit test.```

Adele Park: +1 on the internal blurb. Sanjay, please post a follow-up PR for the mapping validation test. Lia, can you draft a short customer FYI — neutral tone, proactive transparency. Keep it optional to send.

Lia Chen: Draft customer FYI (optional):```
Subject: Brief internal drill — no customer impact
Hi {CustomerName},
We recently ran an internal preflight pager drill as part of planned maintenance preparation. During the drill we identified a configuration issue in our on-call routing that we resolved; there was no impact to your requests or service availability. We’re adding automated checks to prevent recurrence. Thanks for your patience.
```

Matt K: suggestion — if we send the FYI, include a short FAQ link to our incident playbook so customers see remediation steps/assurances. Lia can add the link.

Lia Chen: added link to draft: https://status.redwood.ai/faq/pager-drills. Ready for review.

Sanjay Rao: PR opened for mapping validation test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-config/pull/412. CI is queued.

Adele Park: OK — publish internal note to #eng-ops and #incidents now. Do NOT publish customer FYI unless legal/CS asks. I'll loop in CS for optional sign-off.

ops-bot: Posted internal summary to #eng-ops at 2025-03-15T23:22:05Z.

statuspage-bot: Status page entry created (Draft): https://status.redwood.ai/incident/rdw-drill-20250315 — visibility: internal.

Adele Park: CS pinged. @Matt K keep monitoring for another 15m then handback to regular rotation at 23:45 UTC.

Matt K: monitoring. no real errors in logs, only drill signals.

Sanjay Rao: CI passed for PR #412. Merging and scheduling a follow-up job to run validation daily.

Lia Chen: CS confirmed optional FYI not needed for customers. They prefer proactive outreach only for visible impact.

Adele Park: thanks team. Handing back in 10m. Final internal summary for the record (post to #incidents-archive): ```
Summary: Preflight pager drill uncovered stale oncall mapping causing secondary escalation to fail ~9m. Remediated via hotpatch. No customer impact. Actions: PR #412 mapping validation test merged; daily validation job scheduled; update runbook with drill checklist.
```

ops-bot: Drill complete at 2025-03-15T23:44:27Z. Tagging thread #drill-complete.

statuspage-bot: Status page updated to public: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/rdw-drill-20250315 — Public note: "Scheduled preflight maintenance drill completed. No customer impact. Internal follow-ups in progress."

Adele Park: closing thread. Great run — thanks for quick remediation and keeping comms tight. :thumbsup:

Matt K: nice. learned a small config lesson.

Sanjay Rao: added follow-up tasks to backlog.

Lia Chen: I'll file the final comms artifacts in the incident binder and attach the customer-FYI draft for future use.

Adele Park: end of thread.
